description:
Search the public strategy marketplace -- the platform's own listings, which are digital-asset strategies on crypto pairs -- over every dimension the marketplace page filters on: free text, asset, timeframe, risk level, floors on return, IRR, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, gain-to-pain, win rate, trade count and trades per week, a drawdown ceiling, free-only, beats-benchmarks, the market regime the listing was backtested in, and any sort key. Every filter is applied by the platform; do not fetch a page and filter it yourself. Counts cover the platform's own listings; the marketplace page also merges NexusTrade partner listings, which are not searchable or adoptable here -- say so plainly when a total is compared with the page, never guess at caching or filters. Use it whenever the person wants strategies to try, compare, or adopt -- 'find me a', 'what is on the marketplace', 'best Sharpe on ETH'. To adopt one, call propose_adopt with its strategy_id; never tell the person a strategy is theirs off the back of a search.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

asset_class.description: Keep listings in these asset classes. Platform listings are all digital_assets; stocks, options and futures exist only as NexusTrade partner listings the chat cannot reach.

backtest_direction.description: Keep listings backtested in this market direction, e.g. bull, neutral or bear -- the band get_market_regime reports; or unclassified.

backtest_trend.description: Keep listings backtested in this trend character, e.g. clean, choppy; or unclassified.

backtest_volatility.description: Keep listings backtested in this volatility band, e.g. low, medium, high; or unclassified.

beats_all_benchmarks.description: Keep only listings whose return beat BTC, ETH and the S&P over their own window.

candle_size.description: Duration of one candle, e.g. 1h or 1d.

free_only.description: Keep only listings with no subscription price.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Keep listings whose max drawdown is at or below this, in percent.

min_calmar_ratio.description: Keep listings at or above this Calmar ratio.

min_gain_to_pain_ratio.description: Keep listings at or above this gain-to-pain ratio.

min_irr_pct.description: Keep listings at or above this annualised IRR, in percent.

min_sharpe_ratio.description: Keep listings at or above this Sharpe ratio.

min_sortino_ratio.description: Keep listings at or above this Sortino ratio.

min_total_return_pct.description: Keep listings at or above this total return, in percent.

min_total_trades.description: Keep listings with at least this many trades.

min_trades_per_week.description: Keep listings trading at least this often, per week.

min_win_rate_pct.description: Keep listings at or above this win rate, in percent.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

order.description: desc for best-first on that metric, asc for worst-first.

risk_level.description: Keep listings at any of these risk levels, e.g. low, medium, high.

search.description: Free text matched against listing name, description and creator.

sort.description: The column to order by. Omitted, the marketplace's trending order.

name: search_marketplace
